QuestInfo.name: [Karote] The Tower Complete
QuestInfo.0: The tower is complete. Before heading onward, tell #bNeinheart#k what you saw.
QuestInfo.2:
With a possible #rfalse Adversary#k in the mix, the Alliance hesitates to risk any further advance into the tower. But #bNicky#k, who refused to back down, went up to the top of the tower alone.
Chase #bNicky#k and see what's hidden up there.
QuestInfo.1:
#bNeinheart#k speculated that the person who built the tower may be a #rfalse Adversary#k.
Sensing danger, he suggested calling off the expedition.
But #bNicky#k, who's been anticipating the completion of the tower, isn't ready to leave...
